items.titleZh: FIA确认赫塔尚未获得超级驾照，需额外积分
items.summaryZh: FIA确认赫塔尚未获得超级驾照，需额外积分；IndyCar网站曾错误地将他列为2025年P6，实际为P7；FP1后他拥有39个SL积分。
items.originalTitle: Confirmation from the FIA that Colton Herta doesn't have his Super License yet, and he needs another point There was an error on the IndyCar website a...
items.summaryEn:
Confirmation from the FIA that Colton Herta doesn't have his Super License yet, and he needs another point
There was an error on the IndyCar website at some point that put him in P6 in 2025 when he was actually P7. He has 39 SL points now after today's FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
FIA确认赫塔尚未获得超级驾照，他需要额外积分。
在某个时刻，IndyCar网站上出现了一个错误，将赫塔列为2025年的P6，但实际上他是P7。
FP1后，赫塔现在拥有39个SL积分。
#F1 #MexicoGP
detailEn:
Confirmation from the FIA that Colton Herta doesn't have his Super License yet, and he needs another point
There was an error on the IndyCar website at some point that put him in P6 in 2025 when he was actually P7. He has 39 SL points now after today's FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
